41-City Presale Supervision Fund Dep Tool

An offline interactive model for exploring Dep opportunity costs associated with presale supervision funds across 41 cities. Baseline values are embedded in this page; sensitivity analysis is available for city, LPR, construction and registration timing, release shares, average price, and absorption period.

Model inputs
Financing and market
Construction and registration timing
Policy release shares
All inputs feed into the sensitivity calculation for the selected city. Each stage uses its own calculation base, and release shares are capped at 100%. The embedded baseline peak supervised principal excludes interest.
